name: Mousai
description: Discover songs you are aching to know with an easy-to-use interface. Mousai is a simple application that can recognize songs similar to Shazam. Just click the listen button, and then wait a few seconds. It will magically return the title and artist of that song! Note: This uses the API of audd.io, so it is necessary to log in to their site to get more trials. Why you will love Mousai? - 🎵 Identify songs within seconds or save for later when offline - 🎙️ Recognize from desktop audio or your microphone - 🎸 Build a repertoire of recognized songs - 🎼 Quickly preview the song within the interface - 🌐 Browse and listen the song from different providers - 📱 Easy-to-use user interface
